==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Where is this place?
:'''Villeneuve:''' It is the end of simulated civilizations, where the stars quietly fade away.
:{{DIcon}} Why do the stars fade?
:'''Villeneuve:''' The [[Tethys System]] once dedicated its entire computational capacity to simulating the civilization development within Stellar Matrices.
:'''Villeneuve:''' It generated numerous potential futures based on various decisions to predict the impact of critical choices on the trajectory of a civilization.
:'''Villeneuve:''' Nonetheless, these simulated futures within the Stellar Matrices were either doomed to collapse or became breeding grounds for errors.
:{{DIcon}} What if we introduce a new variable?
:'''Villeneuve:''' A new variable brings the potential for an unknown future.
:'''Villeneuve:''' It could be a force of change, or simply nothing.
:'''Villeneuve:''' You alone hold the answer, don't you? Hee hee hee...
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:'''Villeneuve:''' This dream continues... Good night... Hmm... Eh...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:'''Villeneuve:''' Ah... I feel dizzy. What is this? A nightmare? Wait, who are you? When did you...
:'''Villeneuve:''' Oh, I remember you! You're the Bloom Bearer who guided us through the crisis!
:'''Villeneuve:''' Nice to meet you. I'm Villeneuve. Do you need any help?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing. Just taking a walk here.
:{{DIcon}} You're the one who may need some help.
{{Dialogue End}}
